title: CoVentures Program
desc: A CoVenture with Humblebee means you will gain access to the best possible venture team. They will validate your idea, design and launch it and ensure success. Humblebee are confident in our abilities and are happy to discuss shared risk or equity share.

data.title: CoVentures
data.subtitle: What if your best idea became your next business?
data.outcomeHeading: Every company should be building tomorrow's business alongside today's. AI and modern technology have made that more achievable than ever. That's why we built our CoVentures Program.
data.statement: This program is designed to build new businesses alongside ambitious organisations, from concept to company.
data.featuresIntro: Each program is tailored to your organisation. Here are some activities that may be included.

features.title: Business Opportunity Discovery
features.body: Find opportunities beyond your core business that deserve to become standalone ventures or companies.

features.title: Venture Strategy
features.body: Shape a commercially viable business with a clear market, customer and revenue model.

features.title: Product Creation
features.body: Design and build the product or platform that brings the new business to life.

features.title: Venture Launch
features.body: Take the business to market, acquire early customers and establish commercial traction.

features.title: Growth & Investment
features.body: Prepare the business for scaling through funding, partnerships or continued organic growth.

features.title: Shared Venture Models
features.body: Collaborate through flexible commercial models, including co-investment or shared ownership where appropriate.

forYou: You have ideas that don't fit your core business.
You want to create new growth without disrupting existing operations.
You believe your organisation has untapped commercial potential.
You'd rather validate new businesses than debate them.
You're looking for a partner willing to share both the journey and, where appropriate, the risk.

opportunities.title: Corporate Spin-outs
opportunities.body: Transform internal ideas, technologies or capabilities into standalone ventures.

opportunities.title: AI-Native Businesses
opportunities.body: Create entirely new businesses built around AI from day one.

opportunities.title: Digital Platforms
opportunities.body: Launch marketplaces, SaaS products and digital services beyond your core offering.

opportunities.title: Hidden Assets
opportunities.body: Turn internal expertise, data or intellectual property into commercial products.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships
opportunities.body: Build new ventures alongside customers, suppliers or industry partners.

opportunities.title: Future Growth Engines
opportunities.body: Create a repeatable capability for discovering and launching your next business, not just your next project.

cta.heading: Let's chat
cta.body: I'd love to discuss this program with you and hear your ideas and ambitions. Let's book a meeting and start with coffee and a chat.
